root_cause.confirmed_in_source: Previous renderer emitted one GS v 0 image for the full receipt height; Android wrote the entire byte array in one write without chunk pacing. Receipt content was already raster, not UTF-8/code-page text.
root_cause.hardware_hypothesis: SPP receive-buffer overrun or raster-height limitation is consistent with the reported first heading followed by corrupted pixels. No printer trace or physical reproduction is available; this remains unconfirmed on PHOMARK JHP-A1.

implementation.raster: 576 dots/80mm; default 64 rows per GS v 0 command, optional bounded bandRows up to 128; exact final short band; reset/left alignment once at start; no LF/feed/reset between bands; one feed/cut after final band
implementation.native_transport: Length-aware complete-job validation before socket write. 8-byte raster headers intact; payload chunks at whole-row boundaries, at most 512 bytes (504 bytes for 72-byte rows). Blocking writes plus flush, 60ms chunk pauses, 120ms end-band pause and 500ms final drain.
implementation.limits: 1MiB decoded payload and bounded Base64 input; 15s connect and 180s total send watchdog close socket; reject malformed/truncated/oversized commands; single-job lock; never auto-retry
implementation.failure_recovery: Partial output is possible. UI reports failure and asks to inspect paper and restart printer before manual retry; no printed history on failed send.
implementation.fonts: Bundled OFL Noto Sans Thai variable TTF, font load and document.fonts.ready awaited before measuring/rendering; system Thai fallback validated by non-empty/distinct pixel probes. Font and license verified inside APK.
implementation.shared_paths: Customer/merchant receipts, sale receipts, WAP customer/kitchen slips, long test receipt, and legacy raw-text helper all use the same banded raster encoder. Drawer pulse stays a separate validated command.
implementation.print_history: Successful Bluetooth/USB send now requires explicit paper confirmation. One active print job, recording latch and existing idempotency key prevent double confirmation. Transport success is not claimed as physical print success.
implementation.web_usb: Existing 16KiB sequential transfers retained; partial bytesWritten now rejected without retry

includes: 20 exact raster reconstruction cases, 575/576 widths and 64/128-row bands, right-edge bits
long Thai customer/merchant/WAP receipts, complete band lengths, footer/feed/cut
font readiness, bundled Thai glyphs, blank glyph rejection
Actual signed UAT12 candidate update gate fixture
SPP failure does not record history; manual retry, wait for completion and paper confirmation; double click yields one history call per customer/merchant copy
whole headers/row-aligned chunks, command-like binary payload
byte limits, malformed/truncated job validation before first write
